Context dump for T376 (bake-off worktree/boundary fix; worker flash/T376). Everything below is what the main finding does not otherwise spell out. Per findings/README.md this is the immutable context file; the primary finding is findings/T376-bakeoff-worktree.json.

## (1) How the proof was constructed (commit ordering)
- Commit 1 (90cc86f): tools/bakeoff.sh find_root rewrite + isolation record; docs/infra/bakeoff.md boundary-truth section, retry rule, §6 worktree-proof note.
- Worktree /tmp/weizigo/lane-wt-t376 created from 90cc86f (detached HEAD) so the lane ran the FIXED harness — a proof run against the old find_root would prove nothing.
- Commit 2 (the evidence commit): this findings pair. The evidence commit records hashes of the gitignored run dir, matching the T328/T371 pattern (run dirs live in untracked/bakeoff/, hashes in findings/).

## (2) Why find_root was reworked rather than patched
- The old walk-up had a second latent defect beyond the worktree: it started from the script's dir and could, in a nested-repo layout, return a PARENT checkout's root — the exact silent-wrong-directory failure the brief warns about. Preferring `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` removes the walk entirely, and the <root>/tools/bakeoff.sh realpath sanity guard turns the residual guess case into a die().
- `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` resolves /tmp -> /private/tmp on macOS; the recorded roots (/private/tmp/...) are git's own answer, not a normalization choice of mine.

## (3) Environment / preconditions at run time
- DEEPSEEK_API_KEY set; pi on PATH; the dry-run task is the T328 fixture (explicitly not answer-keyed). Roster for the proof: `deepseek deepseek-v4-flash` (one lane, clean exit-0 demonstration).
- The proof lane's prompt hash (0019daca...) equals T328's recorded dry-run prompt hash and its out.md hash (40f1f3af...) equals T328's — the lane produced byte-identical output to the 2026-08-05 dry run, i.e. the worktree run is a faithful execute() of the same plumbing.

## (4) Acceptance (post-commit, STATE rule 6)
- `zig build deploy` run after commit 2, then `sh tools/smoke.sh`: zero STALE lines, suite PASS. Details in the commit message / managent record.

## (5) Things noticed and deliberately not chased
- untracked/msg/milestone-01-ko-reframe/STATE.md is tracked in git, so a worktree DOES contain it; the boundary claim in the doc is about gitignored key/grading state, and the findings say so explicitly. Re-gitignoring that legacy file is a channel/epic decision, out of scope.
- Concurrent fleet activity in the main working tree (src/differential.zig, src/t366_evse.zig, src/vb_*.zig, src/t372_zrtie.zig, findings/T366-engine-kifu.json modified, uncommitted) was left untouched; my commit contains exactly tools/bakeoff.sh + docs/infra/bakeoff.md (90cc86f) and the two findings files (the evidence commit), verified by tools/git-commit-mine path scoping.
- A per-run --no-tools harness flag for pi lanes is the cheapest real isolation step (sized in the main finding); deliberately not built here (plumbing-only bar, claude lanes need tools, and the brief says don't over-engineer a harness nobody trusts).
